verdict.rationale: Granola supports event-triggered automation mainly through third-party rails — Zapier ('automate what happens after a meeting' across 8,000+ apps), HubSpot folder-based auto-sync of notes to CRM records, automatic transcript deletion after a set time, and automatic follow-up email drafting after external meetings — but these are fixed, pre-built automations rather than a native, general-purpose rule engine where users define arbitrary 'if event X then action Y' logic inside Granola itself. Missing for 10: a native in-app rules/trigger builder, evidence of custom conditional logic beyond folder-based or third-party triggers, and independent confirmation these automations reliably fire on user-defined events.
